title: Qualified Appointments From US Clinicians and Medical Practices

sections.label: 1 - BUILD AND SEGMENT THE DATABASE
sections.note: This covers the first two parts of your post. Every contact is a US physician, clinician, practice or healthcare decision-maker, sorted the way your campaigns will be split.

sections.label: 2 - CLEAN LISTS AND SAFE SENDING
sections.note: This covers list hygiene, sender reputation and deliverability. It is the same setup Lorenzo uses to send over 100,000 cold emails a month on Instantly.

sections.label: 3 - SEQUENCES WITH TWO GOALS
sections.note: This covers the campaigns, the testing and the two goals in your post. Each campaign either books a meeting or sends people to subscribe online.

sections.label: 4 - TRACKING AND HAND-OFF
sections.note: This covers tracking and the hand-off to your team. Your Technical Sales Executive or founders only get the conversations that need a product discussion.

sections.label: 5 - OPTIMISE FROM THE RESULTS
sections.note: Changes are made from real replies, bookings and sign-ups, not guesses.

nodes.label: 1 - We build a database of US physicians, clinicians, practices and decision-makers
2 - Each contact is tagged by specialty, practice type, size and likely use case
3 - Every email address is verified, and bad or duplicate contacts are removed
4 - Emails go out from separate lookalike domains, so your main domain stays safe
5 - New Zapmail mailboxes warm up in Instantly before they send any cold email
6 - Your monthly volume target, which you give us, sets how many mailboxes we buy
7 - Each email has your postal address and a working opt-out, and uses business data only
8 - Claude researches each practice so every email opens with something true about it
9 - We test subject lines, messages and calls to action across a short follow-up sequence
10 - Each campaign asks for one thing, either a booked meeting or an online sign-up
11 - Replies land in one unibox, and clicks, appointments and sign-ups are all tracked
12 - Qualified leads go to your Technical Sales Executive or founders with full context
13 - The weakest subject line or message is replaced once the numbers show a winner

output_sample.context: Replied to email 2, asked how it fits a 4-clinician family practice, prefers Tuesday mornings
